crossRefs.note: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
“The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal…
As he spoke these things, many believed in him.
But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work…
So speak and so do, as men who are to be judged by a law of freedom.
promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by…
I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures:
then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden…
“You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify…
Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

translations.web: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
translations.bsb: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
translations.kjv: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
translations.asv: And I shall walk at liberty; For I have sought thy precepts.
